beats.label: The trial
beats.text: **74** adults with overweight got **3** daily servings of **full-fat** dairy, or very little.
beats.note: Anderson et al., J Nutrition 2026 (U of Toronto)

beats.label: What they saw
beats.text: After **12** weeks: no meaningful change in weight, **body fat** or **cholesterol** vs. low dairy.

beats.label: Bonus
beats.text: Dairy eaters got more **calcium,** **protein** and vitamin D, and better **blood pressure.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Small, only **3** months, part-funded by the **dairy** sector. Saturated fat still isn't **free.**

beats.label: Takeaway
beats.text: The lead researcher's advice: eat a **variety,** and not too much of **anything.**
Follow for one **food rule** a day, tested against **trials.**
